topic: Implementing open hours feature for dashboard
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on implementing 'open hours' functionality. It was determined that the feature would take about two days to complete. The implementation requires adding a new string type to the aggregation and creating a UI toggle switch, though basic open hours filtering already exists on the dashboard.

[p1] emphasized that this feature is critical for an upcoming release.

Separately, [me] confirmed they are working on updates related to 'buses' and 'landfills', which are expected to be finished today.
decisions: The open hours feature will be implemented by the current release.
action_items: [me] to finish work on buses and landfills today.
